verdict.rationale: Canva documents an official command-line tool, but it is scoped to creating and managing Canva Apps SDK apps (canva-docs-14, canva-probe-5), not to driving core Canva work like designs, exports, or assets from the terminal. The evidence describes it only in a single line, with no detail on commands, authentication, or scripted or agent use. Missing for 10: a CLI covering core Canva operations, documented command reference and agent/automation-friendly usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
